text: Fix a pipe deadlock that now hangs CI (PR #47's 'fmt, clippy, tests' job ran 20+ minutes twice; reproduced locally). Four tests in xtask/tests/policy.rs hang: its git() helper (lines 20-38) writes all input to 'git check-attr --stdin' before reading any output, so once the output passes the 64 KB pipe buffer, git blocks writing to the test while the test blocks writing to git. The repository's tracked files grew past that today. Root cause: every place that pipes input to a child writes it all before draining stdout. The same pattern is in Git::exit (crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs, about line 194, used by Athena's own git calls) and the gitleaks runner (crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs, about line 160). Fix all three by writing stdin on its own thread (or an equivalent that drains output concurrently), ideally through one shared helper, and add a test that pipes more than 1 MB through a child that echoes it back.
